carrier_services.name: Northgate Next Day
carrier_services.description: Collected by half four, delivered the next working day.

carrier_services.name: Northgate Standard
carrier_services.description: Two to three working days, and the workhorse of the four.

carrier_services.name: Kestrel Standard
carrier_services.description: Two working days to most addresses, longer past Inverness.

carrier_services.name: Kestrel Two Day
carrier_services.description: A dated two-day service with a booked collection slot.

carrier_services.name: Wendover Economy
carrier_services.description: Three to five working days. The cheapest thing we can put a parcel on.

carrier_services.name: Bluecoat Next Day
carrier_services.description: Next working day, with a photograph on delivery.

carrier_services.name: Bluecoat Before Noon
carrier_services.description: Next working day before twelve, inside the M25 only.
